title: Palindromes p with kp + 1 palindromic (2 <= k <= 6): complete carry-chain classifications and 21 certified zeros of OEIS A083837 - Lean 4 formalization covering 11 OEIS entries
description_html:
This repository contains the accompanying paper (A083833-UNIFIE-paper.pdf) and the Lean 4 (v4.35.0, mathlib v4.35.0) formalization studying decimal palindromes p such that kp + 1 is also a palindrome, covering 11 entries of the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS):

  • Multipliers 2 ≤ k ≤ 6 (source and image sequences): OEIS A069881 (k = 2, Tangente problem 8154), A083829 and A083830 (k = 3), A083831 and A083832 (k = 4), A083833 and A083834 (k = 5), A083835 and A083836 (k = 6).
  • Zero entries across multipliers: OEIS A083837 and A083838 at the 21 indices k ∈ {12, 17, 23, 31, 37, 41, 42, 48, 51, 53, 61, 64, 71, 74, 79, 81, 86, 91, 96, 101, 103}.

Main formalized results:

  • Even-length classifications (iff): For k ∈ {2, 3, 4, 5, 6}, the even-length palindromes p with kp + 1 palindromic are proved in both directions to be the repdigits 55…5, 77…7, 88…8, 22…2, and 99…9, respectively (Repdigits_KP1.lean and per-multiplier modules).
  • Same-length alternating digit classes and alphabets: Necessary and sufficient alternating digit-class conditions (alt_gives_pal) for odd-length members without carry overflow, settling the recorded conjectures of R. Israel (on A083829 and A083831) and M. S. Branicky (on A083833 and A083834), together with a complete two-branch characterization at k = 6 (A083835.lean).
  • Universal nonexistence at 21 indices of A083837 and A083838: Prefix-suffix border obstructions (A083837.lean, A083838.lean) ruling out candidate palindromes of arbitrary length at all 21 displayed zero indices (previously recorded for p < 1015).

Verification perimeter and archive contents:

  • Toolchain: Lean 4 v4.35.0 and mathlib v4.35.0 (pinned in lean-toolchain and lake-manifest.json).
  • Axiom footprint: 0 sorry, 0 native_decide; all declarations depend solely on the three standard Lean axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), audited in axioms-*.txt.
  • Structure: 5 main classification modules, 4 image re-export modules, Repdigits_KP1.lean, A083837.lean, A083838.lean, frozen specification and inhabitedness checks (Spec_*.lean, Check_Spec_*.lean, Check_AntiVacuite_*.lean), LaTeX sources, build script (verify_all.sh), and SHA-256 manifest (MANIFEST.sha256).

Supersedes and extends the earlier standalone A083833/A083834 development (10.5281/zenodo.24078012).

For convenience the record also ships A083833-UNIFIE-zenodo-package.tar.gz, a single flat archive containing the same 94 files.
